cohort: The study included postnatal women and newborns in maternity and neonatal wards across three public hospitals in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.
finding: The study observed substantial overuse of antibiotics in postnatal women and newborns, with high prescribing rates predominantly for medical prophylaxis.
mod_finding: Antibiotic prescribing rates ranged from 90% to 100% in women after cesarean section, and from 1.4% to 63% in women after vaginal delivery.
